records.name: Fighting Pose K
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop after The Ginyu Force Strikes
records.skill_description: Perform a Ginyu Force pose to temporarily gain Super Armor and resist flinching.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation states that the activated buff grants Super Armor for 8 seconds. The skill is categorized as a Power Up Super; the buff can be refreshed through subsequent power-up usage according to the documented behavior.
records.acquisition_notes: Canonical current route is the Skill Shop after the relevant story progression. Older Xenoverse/PQ39 references are retained only as historical cross-game/context evidence and are not substituted for the current route.
records.pve_notes: No PQ Ultimate Finish requirement is established for the current Skill Shop route.
records.pvp_notes: Super Armor changes how incoming attacks interact with the user, but matchup/frame-specific claims remain version-sensitive.
